ma.offAppHide(function callback)

Cancel the listening for the events of switching a Mini Program to the backend.

Parameter

function callback

Callback function for switching a Mini Program to the backend.

Sample Code

let _this;
let test1 = function () {
    console.log('aaa')
    _this.setData({
        detail: _this.data.detail + '\r\n' + 'offAppHide:ok',
    })
};

Page({
    offAppHide () {
        _this.setData({
            detail: _this.data.detail + '\r\n' + 'offAppHide',
        })
        ma.offAppHide(test1)
    }
})
